name: Easy Piano
summary:
# Your piano. Your music. A little magic.

Turn your real digital piano into an immersive mixed-reality experience. Beautiful falling notes guide your fingers, keys light up as you play, and music comes to life right above your keyboard.

## **IMPORTANT — REQUIRED HARDWARE**

**EasyPiano requires:**
- Meta Quest 3 headset
- 88-key digital piano with USB MIDI support
- USB data cable connecting the piano directly to the headset

**A compatible physical instrument is essential.** Acoustic pianos, Bluetooth MI
